name: Draw Me a Fact
title: Draw Me a Fact Studio
description: Autonomous production studio for the @drawmeafact YouTube Shorts channel: writes the five-sentence script, generates the voiceover, animates the film frame by frame, muxes the audio, runs the QA gate, and prepares the upload package.

auth.notes: No credentials are required for read-only tools and dry runs. Publishing uses server-side secrets (YOUTUBE_*, IG_*) that are never exposed to the client.

tools.name: describe_studio
tools.description: What this connector is, and which integrations are configured right now.

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List the pre-verified episode slate, flagged with what has already shipped.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Full package for one slate episode (number or slug): script, scenes, sources, word count.

identifier.description: Episode number or slug, e.g. 11 or mountains-10km-limit

tools.name: plan_script
tools.description: Draft a five-sentence script for a topic and check it against the script contract. No render.

tools.name: produce_episode
tools.description: Produce one episode end to end: voice, score, frames, mux, SRT, upload pack, QA gate. Never uploads unless publish_mode asks for it.

tools.name: run_qa
tools.description: Re-run the QA gate on the latest film (or a path you pass).

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Everything on disk: MP4, SRT, youtube_pack.md, contact sheet, voice WAVs, timing JSON.

tools.name: score_info
tools.description: The locked audio chain, sample rate and timing constants.

rate_limits.produce_episode: 1 concurrent render; roughly 1-2 minutes of CPU per film
